title: Installed Command Requirement
purpose: Defines the governed identity and classification of commands and executable capabilities that transported common validation requires from an initialized repository.

normative_requirements.text: The product shall define `installed-command-requirement` as a governed validation-workflow dependency classified either as a repository-relative command/capability that must resolve from initialized output or as an explicitly external/platform-provided dependency.

Every repository-relative command invoked directly or indirectly as a required stable entry point by transported common validation shall have an installed-command requirement. A repository-relative requirement shall identify the stable repository-relative path and required executable capability.

The required stable validation/test surfaces governed by `product.validation-test-surface`, including `repo/scripts/test-validation`, `product/scripts/test-validation`, and `product/scripts/test-product`, shall be repository-relative installed-command requirements whenever common validation requires them.

Production-validation entry points required by transported common validation shall likewise be represented as repository-relative installed-command requirements rather than assumed to exist because they exist in repo-spec.

An external/platform-provided dependency shall be identified explicitly by accepted authority and shall not be represented as a repository-relative installed path. Absence of explicit external/platform classification shall not permit a missing repository-relative command to be treated as external.

Repository-relative installed-command requirements shall be stable interface obligations and shall not require transport of repo-spec source-development-only tests, fixtures, or internal helper topology unless those materials are separately proven necessary to satisfy an installed stable interface.
Installed-command requirement identity shall be deterministic for equivalent accepted validation-workflow authority and repository state.

This contract shall not prescribe the concrete output-inventory representation, material-manifest entry shape beyond existing authority, wrapper implementation, support-library layout, closure algorithm, diagnostic wording, or upgrade propagation mechanics.

conformance.rationale: Current accepted repo-spec authority declares no governed generic product implementation-test obligation for this requirement at product/scripts/test-product; source-development tests and validation self-tests are separate surfaces. Future activation requires a governed correspondence update.
